review_candidates.title: Network Performance & Automation Engineer
review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Network Performance & Automation Engineer based in India. As a Network Performance & Automation Engineer, you will drive the monitoring, analysis, automation, and continuous improvement of complex enterprise network environments. You’ll work across WAN, SD-WAN, campus, data center, cloud, and security infrastructure to improve performance, reliability, and operational efficiency. The role combines deep network troubleshooting with automation, telemetry, and observability to identify issues before they impact services. You’ll develop intelligent workflows and reusable tools that streamline health checks, incident triage, reporting, and remediation. You’ll also collaborate with network, security, cloud, application, and service desk teams to resolve end-to-end performance challenges. This is an opportunity to bring automation and data-driven engineering practices into a modern, multi-vendor infrastructure environment. Accountabilities Analyze network performance across latency, jitter, packet loss, throughput, bandwidth utilization, application response times, and device health. Identify performance bottlenecks across WAN, SD-WAN overlays, firewalls, load balancers, wireless, LAN, data center, and cloud connectivity. Establish performance baselines, produce trend analyses and capacity forecasts, and recommend service improvements. Develop automation scripts and workflows for network health checks, configuration validation, incident triage, reporting, and remediation support. Integrate monitoring, observability, ITSM, CMDB, SD-WAN, firewall, and cloud platforms using APIs and automation workflows. Build reusable dashboards, reports, runbooks, and self-service automation capabilities that improve operational efficiency. Work with SNMP, NetFlow/IPFIX, syslog, streaming telemetry, synthetic testing, logs, events, and packet-capture data to improve network visibility. Configure and optimize monitoring thresholds, alerts, dashboards, and correlation rules to reduce alert noise and improve incident detection. Perform root cause analysis using telemetry, flow analysis, path visibility, device metrics, and application dependency insights. Drive automation-led reductions in manual effort, faster incident resolution, and improved service availability. Collaborate with network, security, cloud, application, and service desk teams to improve end-to-end service performance. Create and maintain standard operating procedures, troubleshooting playbooks, and documented performance improvement actions. Support the adoption of AIOps, event correlation, anomaly detection, predictive analytics, and closed-loop automation where appropriate. Requirements 6–12+ years of experience in network engineering, network performance, automation, observability, or related infrastructure roles. Strong understanding of enterprise networking, including routing, switching, SD-WAN, firewalls, load balancers, and cloud connectivity. Hands-on scripting and automation experience using Python, Ansible, REST APIs, JSON, YAML, and related automation frameworks. Experience with network monitoring and observability platforms such as SolarWinds, ThousandEyes, Cisco DNA Center, vManage, Splunk, Grafana, ELK, AppDynamics, or comparable tools. Strong capabilities in packet analysis, flow analysis, network performance troubleshooting, and root cause analysis. Experience integrating infrastructure platforms and operational tools through APIs and automated workflows. Knowledge of ITSM workflows, ServiceNow integration, CMDB data models, and incident/problem management is an advantage. Exposure to cloud platforms, SASE/SSE, Zscaler, Prisma Access, Fortinet, Cisco, Palo Alto, F5, or other multi-vendor environments is preferred. Familiarity with AIOps, event correlation, anomaly detection, predictive analytics, or closed-loop automation is a strong advantage. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a proactive approach to identifying performance issues and operational improvements. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and cross-functional teams. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. Preferred certifications include CCNP Enterprise, CCNP Security, Python, Ansible, DevNet Associate/Professional, monitoring or observability certifications, cloud certifications, or ITIL. Benefits Fully remote working environment. Full-time employment with a mid-senior-level scope. Opportunity to work across complex enterprise networking, cloud, security, and SD-WAN environments. Hands-on exposure to automation, observability, telemetry, AIOps, and modern network engineering practices. Opportunity to build reusable automation capabilities and directly improve operational efficiency. review_candidates.title: Head of Infrastructure (Remote)
review_candidates.description: Business Unit Cubic Corporation Company Details When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners. We have a top-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com. Job Details The Head of Infrastructure & Platforms is responsible for the operational leadership, delivery, and continuous improvement of the organization's global infrastructure and platform services. The role manages multiple technical disciplines, including cloud infrastructure, enterprise networking, identity services, endpoint management, server and hosting platforms, and related infrastructure operations. The postholder ensures that these services are secure, reliable, supportable, and delivered in accordance with approved business, financial, security, and compliance requirements. Working within the direction set by senior IT leadership, the role establishes departmental objectives, operating procedures, work plans, and priorities; manages the department budget; allocates resources; and delegates assignments across experienced technical professionals and, where applicable, subordinate managers. The successful candidate will combine effective people leadership with broad technical knowledge and sound tactical decision-making. The role is expected to resolve complex operational issues, deliver larger infrastructure projects, and translate approved technology plans into practical, measurable outcomes. Key Responsibilities Departmental Leadership & Operational Planning Establish departmental objectives, operating procedures, work plans, delivery priorities, and performance expectations in line with approved IT strategy and organizational policies. Translate approved infrastructure roadmaps into operational plans, resource assignments, schedules, and measurable departmental outcomes. Make implementation decisions within delegated authority and escalate matters that require broader functional or enterprise direction. Provide recommendations to senior IT leadership regarding infrastructure architecture, operational risk, service improvement, and technology investment. Infrastructure & Platform Service Delivery Manage the reliable and secure delivery of enterprise networking, cloud infrastructure, data center and hosting services, identity platforms, endpoint management, collaboration infrastructure, and server services. Coordinate the work of multiple infrastructure disciplines and ensure clear ownership, effective handoffs, and consistent operating practices. Monitor service availability, capacity, performance, supportability, technical debt, and lifecycle risk, implementing corrective plans where required. Establish and review departmental KPIs, SLAs, operational health measures, and service improvement actions. Cloud & Platform Implementation Manage delivery of cloud infrastructure services across Azure, AWS, and related hosting environments in accordance with approved architecture and governance standards. Plan and deliver approved cloud migrations, platform upgrades, infrastructure rationalization, and legacy hosting reduction activities. Ensure cloud and hosting environments meet defined requirements for resilience, security, cost, supportability, documentation, and operational readiness. Work with application owners, architects, Security, and service providers to sequence and deliver migration and modernization plans. Network Architecture & Engineering Oversight Manage enterprise network services and provide technical direction across SD-WAN, routing and switching, firewalls, network segmentation, VLAN and VRF design, internet and WAN connectivity, and hybrid cloud networking. Oversee network workstreams for site openings, relocations, consolidations, lab environments, and business segmentation initiatives. Review technical designs and implementation plans to confirm alignment with approved standards, security controls, operational support requirements, and change processes. Advise technical teams on moderately complex network and infrastructure matters and coordinate resolution of issues that span disciplines. Endpoint, Identity & Security Platforms Manage infrastructure delivery and operational support for endpoint management, device compliance, identity services, privileged access controls, endpoint security platforms, and infrastructure hardening standards. Deliver approved transitions and improvements involving Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender, Entra ID, Active Directory, Azure Arc, and related endpoint and identity services. Coordinate implementation with Information Security, Service Desk, regional IT, and technical suppliers. Ensure controls and operational procedures are applied consistently, documented, monitored, and remediated where gaps are identified. Compliance, Resilience & Risk Implement infrastructure controls and remediation plans required to support CMMC, NIST-based controls, ISO standards, government or defense requirements, and internal audit activities. Manage departmental activities relating to network segmentation, access governance, asset and configuration records, infrastructure baselines, disaster recovery, and business continuity. Maintain evidence and documentation required to demonstrate that assigned infrastructure controls are operating as intended. Identify departmental risks, assess operational impact, define corrective actions, and report significant risks to senior IT leadership. IT Service Management & Change Governance Ensure infrastructure teams comply with established Incident, Problem, Change, Asset, Configuration, Request, and Access Management processes. Represent Infrastructure in CAB, problem review, major incident, service review, and operational governance forums. Oversee pilot planning, implementation sequencing, risk and impact assessment, business and Service Desk communications, rollback planning, and post-implementation review for major infrastructure changes. Improve departmental procedures and supporting ServiceNow workflows within delegated process ownership and governance. Budget, Suppliers & Cost Management Prepare, manage, and monitor the departmental infrastructure budget in accordance with approved financial plans and delegated authority. Manage day-to-day relationships and performance across managed service providers, cloud providers, network carriers, hosting providers, security vendors, and technology partners. Support sourcing, contract renewal, service review, and purchasing decisions by providing technical requirements, usage data, risk assessments, and recommendations. Identify and implement approved opportunities to consolidate services, reduce unnecessary cost, improve licensing efficiency, and optimize infrastructure consumption. People Leadership & Global Ways of Working Manage and develop experienced infrastructure professionals across multiple disciplines and regions and, where applicable, oversee subordinate managers or team leads. Delegate assignments, establish accountability, review delivery, coach team members, and address capability or performance gaps through established management processes. Build effective operational collaboration across regional and offshore teams, supporting consistent standards and follow-the-sun delivery. Maintain departmental succession plans, skills development priorities, architecture documentation, standards, runbooks, diagrams, and knowledge-sharing practices. Stakeholder Collaboration Work regularly with senior management, Security, Architecture, application teams, business stakeholders, suppliers, and customers on infrastructure matters affecting several operational areas. Present analysis, delivery options, risks, cost implications, and recommendations to support departmental decisions. Influence stakeholders in sensitive or complex situations while preserving productive working relationships and maintaining focus on approved outcomes. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. A minimum of 12 years of relevant infrastructure experience with a Bachelor's degree, or 8 years with a Master's degree, or equivalent experience. Significant experience managing a department or multiple infrastructure disciplines, including experienced technical professionals and/or subordinate managers. Demonstrated experience delivering complex infrastructure projects and operational improvements within approved strategy, budget, and governance. Broad technical knowledge across enterprise networking, cloud platforms, identity services, endpoint management, infrastructure security, server platforms, and IT operations. Experience managing departmental budgets, suppliers, contracts, service performance, and cost optimization activities. Working knowledge of ITSM processes and platforms, including Change, Incident, Problem, Asset, Configuration, Request, and Access Management. Strong written, verbal, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and recommendations to senior management. Ability to obtain and maintain security clearance if required. The description provided above is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all job duties, responsibilities and requirements. Duties, responsibilities and requirements may change over time and according to business need. ‎ Cubic Pay Range $165,000.00 - $190,000.00* + benefits. ‎ ‎ Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. The base pay for this position ranges from our lowest geographic market up to our highest geographic market. ‎ The Cubic pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Trabajar en conjunto con los equipos de Infraestructura, Sistemas y Seguridad de la Información. ¿Qué buscamos? Formación técnica o universitaria en Sistemas, Informática, Redes, Tecnologías de la Información o carreras relacionadas. Experiencia previa brindando soporte técnico a usuarios finales. Conocimientos de Windows y Microsoft 365/Office. Conocimientos de TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi y VPN. Experiencia utilizando herramientas de acceso remoto. Conocimiento de herramientas de gestión de tickets / ITSM. Conocimientos de hardware, periféricos y troubleshooting. Buenas habilidades de comunicación, organización y priorización. Será Valorado Contar Con Experiencia en empresas de logística, transporte, distribución, depósitos o centros de distribución. review_candidates.title: Head of Infrastructure (Remote)
review_candidates.description: Business Unit Cubic Corporation Company Details When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Job Details The Head of Infrastructure & Platforms is responsible for the operational leadership, delivery, and continuous improvement of the organization's global infrastructure and platform services. The role manages multiple technical disciplines, including cloud infrastructure, enterprise networking, identity services, endpoint management, server and hosting platforms, and related infrastructure operations. The postholder ensures that these services are secure, reliable, supportable, and delivered in accordance with approved business, financial, security, and compliance requirements. Working within the direction set by senior IT leadership, the role establishes departmental objectives, operating procedures, work plans, and priorities; manages the department budget; allocates resources; and delegates assignments across experienced technical professionals and, where applicable, subordinate managers. The successful candidate will combine effective people leadership with broad technical knowledge and sound tactical decision-making. The role is expected to resolve complex operational issues, deliver larger infrastructure projects, and translate approved technology plans into practical, measurable outcomes. Key Responsibilities Departmental Leadership & Operational Planning Establish departmental objectives, operating procedures, work plans, delivery priorities, and performance expectations in line with approved IT strategy and organizational policies. Translate approved infrastructure roadmaps into operational plans, resource assignments, schedules, and measurable departmental outcomes. Make implementation decisions within delegated authority and escalate matters that require broader functional or enterprise direction. Provide recommendations to senior IT leadership regarding infrastructure architecture, operational risk, service improvement, and technology investment. Infrastructure & Platform Service Delivery Manage the reliable and secure delivery of enterprise networking, cloud infrastructure, data center and hosting services, identity platforms, endpoint management, collaboration infrastructure, and server services. Coordinate the work of multiple infrastructure disciplines and ensure clear ownership, effective handoffs, and consistent operating practices. Monitor service availability, capacity, performance, supportability, technical debt, and lifecycle risk, implementing corrective plans where required. Establish and review departmental KPIs, SLAs, operational health measures, and service improvement actions. Cloud & Platform Implementation Manage delivery of cloud infrastructure services across Azure, AWS, and related hosting environments in accordance with approved architecture and governance standards. Plan and deliver approved cloud migrations, platform upgrades, infrastructure rationalization, and legacy hosting reduction activities. Ensure cloud and hosting environments meet defined requirements for resilience, security, cost, supportability, documentation, and operational readiness. Work with application owners, architects, Security, and service providers to sequence and deliver migration and modernization plans. Network Architecture & Engineering Oversight Manage enterprise network services and provide technical direction across SD-WAN, routing and switching, firewalls, network segmentation, VLAN and VRF design, internet and WAN connectivity, and hybrid cloud networking. Oversee network workstreams for site openings, relocations, consolidations, lab environments, and business segmentation initiatives. Review technical designs and implementation plans to confirm alignment with approved standards, security controls, operational support requirements, and change processes. Advise technical teams on moderately complex network and infrastructure matters and coordinate resolution of issues that span disciplines. Endpoint, Identity & Security Platforms Manage infrastructure delivery and operational support for endpoint management, device compliance, identity services, privileged access controls, endpoint security platforms, and infrastructure hardening standards. Deliver approved transitions and improvements involving Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender, Entra ID, Active Directory, Azure Arc, and related endpoint and identity services. Coordinate implementation with Information Security, Service Desk, regional IT, and technical suppliers. Ensure controls and operational procedures are applied consistently, documented, monitored, and remediated where gaps are identified. Compliance, Resilience & Risk Implement infrastructure controls and remediation plans required to support CMMC, NIST-based controls, ISO standards, government or defense requirements, and internal audit activities. Manage departmental activities relating to network segmentation, access governance, asset and configuration records, infrastructure baselines, disaster recovery, and business continuity. Maintain evidence and documentation required to demonstrate that assigned infrastructure controls are operating as intended. Identify departmental risks, assess operational impact, define corrective actions, and report significant risks to senior IT leadership. IT Service Management & Change Governance Ensure infrastructure teams comply with established Incident, Problem, Change, Asset, Configuration, Request, and Access Management processes. Represent Infrastructure in CAB, problem review, major incident, service review, and operational governance forums. Oversee pilot planning, implementation sequencing, risk and impact assessment, business and Service Desk communications, rollback planning, and post-implementation review for major infrastructure changes. Improve departmental procedures and supporting ServiceNow workflows within delegated process ownership and governance. Budget, Suppliers & Cost Management Prepare, manage, and monitor the departmental infrastructure budget in accordance with approved financial plans and delegated authority. Manage day-to-day relationships and performance across managed service providers, cloud providers, network carriers, hosting providers, security vendors, and technology partners. Support sourcing, contract renewal, service review, and purchasing decisions by providing technical requirements, usage data, risk assessments, and recommendations. Identify and implement approved opportunities to consolidate services, reduce unnecessary cost, improve licensing efficiency, and optimize infrastructure consumption. People Leadership & Global Ways of Working Manage and develop experienced infrastructure professionals across multiple disciplines and regions and, where applicable, oversee subordinate managers or team leads. Delegate assignments, establish accountability, review delivery, coach team members, and address capability or performance gaps through established management processes. Build effective operational collaboration across regional and offshore teams, supporting consistent standards and follow-the-sun delivery. Maintain departmental succession plans, skills development priorities, architecture documentation, standards, runbooks, diagrams, and knowledge-sharing practices. Stakeholder Collaboration Work regularly with senior management, Security, Architecture, application teams, business stakeholders, suppliers, and customers on infrastructure matters affecting several operational areas. Present analysis, delivery options, risks, cost implications, and recommendations to support departmental decisions. Influence stakeholders in sensitive or complex situations while preserving productive working relationships and maintaining focus on approved outcomes. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. A minimum of 12 years of relevant infrastructure experience with a Bachelor's degree, or 8 years with a Master's degree, or equivalent experience. Significant experience managing a department or multiple infrastructure disciplines, including experienced technical professionals and/or subordinate managers. Demonstrated experience delivering complex infrastructure projects and operational improvements within approved strategy, budget, and governance. Broad technical knowledge across enterprise networking, cloud platforms, identity services, endpoint management, infrastructure security, server platforms, and IT operations. Experience managing departmental budgets, suppliers, contracts, service performance, and cost optimization activities. Working knowledge of ITSM processes and platforms, including Change, Incident, Problem, Asset, Configuration, Request, and Access Management. Strong written, verbal, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and recommendations to senior management. Ability to obtain and maintain security clearance if required. The description provided above is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all job duties, responsibilities and requirements. Duties, responsibilities and requirements may change over time and according to business need. ‎ Cubic Pay Range $165,000.00 - $190,000.00* + benefits. ‎ ‎ Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. The base pay for this position ranges from our lowest geographic market up to our highest geographic market. ‎ The Cubic pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law. ‎ ‎ Worker Type Employee ‎ We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. We do not discriminate based on any protected characteristic under applicable law.
